name: Gasthof Jägerwirt
beschreibung: The Gasthof Jägerwirt in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser is a traditional inn in Tyrol. Centrally located in the village, it is only a short distance from the valley station of the Wilder Kaiser cable car. The house boasts a cosy atmosphere with classic wood-panelled dining rooms. In the restaurant, guests can look forward to authentic regional specialities. The surrounding area is ideal for summer hikes and winter skiing. The guest rooms are functionally furnished. A garden with a sunbathing lawn is available for relaxing moments outdoors. The inn serves as a premier starting point for tours into the Kaisergebirge.
